title: English Supplement — 2025 and 2026 Amendments to Gwangju Military Air Base Relocation Decree
title_original: 광주 군 공항 이전 및 종전부지 개발 등에 관한 특별법 시행령
full_text:
SUPPLEMENTAL ENGLISH TRANSLATION — MISSING PROVISIONS OF THE ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SPECIAL ACT ON RELOCATION OF GWANGJU MILITARY AIR BASE AND DEVELOPMENT OF PREVIOUS SITE

This supplemental text preserves the previously recorded English Decree, kr-014494-280999-en, unchanged. It translates the provisions and amendment details present in the Korean version kr-014494-287263-ko that are absent from that English record. It does not replace the existing complete English statutory record.

AMENDMENT TO ARTICLE 9 (3) AND (4), EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2026
Article 9 (Preferential Treatment for Local Enterprises)
(3) Where a relocation and support project operator has established criteria for preferential treatment under paragraph (2), the operator shall post the details on its website and forward them to the competent Mayor of the Integrated Special City having jurisdiction over the area where the Gwangju Military Air Base relocation project and the support project for the area adjacent to the relocation site are being implemented. <Amended on June 23, 2026>
(4) The competent Mayor of the Integrated Special City shall post the criteria for preferential treatment received under paragraph (3) on the website of the relevant Integrated Special City. <Amended on June 23, 2026>

MISSING SPECIFIC AMENDMENT TEXT UNDER ADDENDA (ORGANIZATIONAL REGULATIONS OF THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE AND ECONOMY) <Presidential Decree No. 35947, Dec. 30, 2025>
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
Paragraphs 1 through 110 omitted.
Paragraph 111: The Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Relocation of Gwangju Military Air Base and Development of Previous Site is amended as follows:
In Article 4 (6), "Minister of Economy and Finance" is replaced with "Minister of Planning and Budget".
In Article 4 (7), "Minister of National Defense and Minister of Economy and Finance" is replaced with "Minister of National Defense, Minister of Finance and Economy and Minister of Planning and Budget".
In Article 9 (2), "Minister of Economy and Finance" is replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy".
Paragraphs 112 through 313 omitted.

MISSING ADDENDA (ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE LOCAL AUTONOMY ACT) <Presidential Decree No. 36424, June 23, 2026>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on July 1, 2026. <Proviso omitted>
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
Paragraphs 1 through 4 omitted.
Paragraph 5: The Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Relocation of Gwangju Military Air Base and Development of Previous Site is amended as follows:
In Article 9 (3), "competent Metropolitan City Mayor and Do Governor" is replaced with "competent Mayor of the Integrated Special City".
In Article 9 (4), "competent Metropolitan City Mayor and Do Governor" is replaced with "competent Mayor of the Integrated Special City", and "the relevant Metropolitan City and Do" is replaced with "the relevant Integrated Special City".
Paragraphs 6 through 34 omitted.
